description: This file is a script for analyzing and auditing documentation links within a project's documentation directory. It includes functions to resolve routes, walk the directory tree, sanitize configuration objects, and check for broken links in markdown files based on relative paths, route mappings, and navigation entries.

methods.name: walk
methods.description: Recursively traverses a directory to list all file paths, ignoring hidden entries.

methods.name: normalizeSlashes
methods.description: Converts backslashes in a path to forward slashes for consistency.

methods.name: isLocalizedDocPath
methods.description: Checks if a given documentation path is localized based on language code prefixes.

methods.name: isGeneratedTranslatedDoc
methods.description: Determines if the relative path corresponds to a generated translated documentation page.

methods.name: collectNavPageEntries
methods.description: Recursively extracts page entries from navigation node objects.
